name: Jaylin Herskovitz
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
department: Computer Science; Tufts AI, Design, and Accessibility (TADA) Lab
fitReason: Recent Assistant Professor with substantive learned visual-assistance implementation and a spatial/mobile accessibility agenda. A lower-physical-confidence assistive-perception backup; current master recruitment is generic and does not establish outside summer eligibility.

physicalEvidence.summary: Full CHI 2026 A11yExtensions implements YOLO-based camera framing guidance and GPT-4o/Gemini visual-answer cross-checking through iOS Shortcuts and a companion app. Two blind accessibility professionals co-designed and evaluated the extensions. Human users move the camera and take the photo; automatic photo capture was explicitly not implemented. This is actual assistive-perception software, not robot control. The work originated in her Michigan doctoral research and should not be called a new Tufts robot deployment.
